# Third-party font: Spleen

- Origin: https://github.com/fcambus/spleen
- Tag: `2.2.0`
- License: BSD 2-Clause (see `LICENSE` in this folder)

`spleen-6x12.bdf` and `spleen-8x16.bdf` are converted by `tools/bdf2inc.py` into
`arm9/source/gfx/fonts/*.inc` (Latin-1 range only). Regenerate the `.inc` files after updating a BDF.
